ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low contrast ratio; the visible surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity dark pixels with high-intensity pixels limited to localized circular scarring and water spray at the lower boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge; characterized by irregular sharp peaks and deep valleys from the median notch to the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-toned diagonal linear disruptions detected on the lower quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular white rosette scars distributed across the ventral surface; extensive irregular serration/tearing along the trailing edge suggests historical mechanical wear or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography providing a unique geometric profile.
